requestVerbatim: No hay mas posibilidades de fuentes?

providers.name: HearThis.at
providers.finding: Public API JSON can be read by the actual Pages origin with no application key or account. A 301-second control advances unmuted after one trusted Play click and after a seek to 120 seconds. Iritsi search instead returns a 4287-second DJ mix with a different title and artist, which is rejected; the artist search reports no results. This proves provider transport feasibility, not a matching catalog fallback or mobile background behavior. The control disallows downloading and has no declared open license.

providers.name: Internet Archive
providers.finding: Broader Pirritx/Porrotx full-text search returns 24 audio items, unlike the earlier exact and creator-only searches. The related Egiozu Euskaraz item uploaded by AEK has readable metadata and a full 126.8325-second MP3; unmuted playback advances at the beginning and after a middle seek. It is not Iritsi da Eguna. The uploader declares Public Domain Mark; this is recorded metadata, not independent verification of rights or original-master identity.

providers.name: Jamendo
providers.finding: The official read API requires a developer-registered application client_id, not a login by each listener. Public read methods do not inherently need user OAuth or a backend. The documented test application is suspended in the earlier browser probe; this does not rule out the provider or prove an empty catalog. A valid own application ID and real browser/audio validation remain necessary.

providers.name: JioSaavn / Gaana
providers.finding: Ten bounded public API fetches from Pages and opaque-origin controls return network HTTP 403 with unreadable CORS responses. Two corrected public JSONP controls also return HTTP 403 without callbacks. The initial two JSONP timeouts had a probe setup bug and are explicitly excluded. These results do not establish that the exact song is absent. No third-party API proxy was used.

providers.name: QQ Music
providers.finding: An isolated anonymous provider JSONP search returns the exact title, artist, album and 169-second duration (public ID 216035983, mid 003EcCKt0Wd30D), plus a valid control. Both the initial vkey requests and a final check with corrected standard AAC filenames return result 104003 and no media URL for exact and control. The final check uses already verified public IDs, avoiding a repeated search that returned service 2001. Searching successfully and payPlay=0 metadata do not prove full audio availability; no undocumented cause is assigned to those codes.

providers.name: NetEase Cloud Music / ccMixter
providers.finding: The bounded exact and control fetches are unreadable from the Pages origin. ccMixter diagnostics identify MissingAllowOriginHeader. No catalog-absence conclusion is drawn from transport failures.

providers.name: Yandex Music / VK Music
providers.finding: Yandex exact and positive-control search requests both receive network HTTP 403 and MissingAllowOriginHeader from Pages; metadata is unreadable, so no absence claim is made. No protected file-info or signing route is attempted. The reviewed VK client uses a logged-in session, cookies and the current user's ID. No anonymous static full-audio route is established for VK; it was a client-source review, not an authenticated playback test.

providers.name: Free Music Archive / PeerTube
providers.finding: These remain separate documentation leads. Free Music Archive states its API was retired and requires permission for hotlinking or automated search. PeerTube provides per-instance video/file search APIs and federated discovery; it is not a single complete commercial music catalog. No playback or exact-song recovery is claimed for either.

conclusion: There are additional viable public-audio catalogs: HearThis and Internet Archive join the previously tested Audius as browser-compatible candidates. None of the new tests establishes recovery of Iritsi da Eguna or a general canonical commercial-catalog fallback. Jamendo remains a possible read-only integration with an own registered app ID. No empty provider framework or unverified source was added to playback.
